structured_output.summary: Candidate 1d98ee0d remediates all six findings from the prior Claude desktop review at 64ab0fe2. The P2 redaction gap for 'desktop write authority enabled' is closed in apps/desktop/src/main/read-model.mjs:320; the source-preview repo-root containment now resolves both the repo root and the candidate path through fs.promises.realpath and compares canonical paths with explicit separator handling (read-model.mjs:60-66); apps/desktop/src/main/security-policy.mjs:30 drops style-src 'unsafe-inline' and the change is asserted by apps/desktop/test/security-policy.test.mjs:67-68; src/desktop-read-model.mjs:449-450 replaces the dead ternaries with hardcoded false and a comment that artifact-supplied publish state is observed only; src/desktop-read-model.mjs:466-471 looks up factory_gate_opening and factory_stage_6_7 summaries by source_id rather than by ordinal slice; and parseDesktopReadModelArgs/parseDesktopAuthorityBoundaryArgs/parseDesktopPackagingManifestArgs (src/desktop-read-model.mjs:794-813, src/desktop-authority-boundary.mjs:405-423, src/desktop-packaging-manifest.mjs:356-375) now throw 'Unknown argument' on any unknown --flag with a dedicated CLI regression test in test/desktop-read-model.test.mjs:169-177. Symlink-escape behaviour is also locked down with a new test in apps/desktop/test/read-model.test.mjs:211-248 that creates an outside-the-repo symlink and asserts the preview is blocked with 'escapes the repository root'. The 2026-06-15 release decision packet, production launch checklist, and release note/tag draft consistently frame production PASS, enterprise PASS, GitHub independent approval, protected closeout, tag push, GitHub Release publication, desktop write authority, runtime execution, connector write, secret read, raw source exposure, and deployment authorization as not granted, not pursued, or remaining false; no overclaim observed. The provided local validation evidence (git diff --check pass, npm audit 0 vulnerabilities for apps/desktop, desktop:local-preflight pass, validate:core pass, release:candidate --check pass, release:freeze --check pass, platform:release-readiness-control-plane --check pass with deployment allowed false, platform:release-bundle-provenance --check pass, platform:launch-non-human-readiness --check pass with authority flags closed, npm test 2670/0) is consistent with the read-only authority surface visible in code: release_projection.tag_pushed and github_release_published are hardcoded false, factory_projection gate/runtime/stage authority remain forced closed under hostile fixture input, the desktop preload exposes only four read methods, and the shell seed state keeps all 13 closed authority flags at false. No P0/P1/P2 regression introduced. Two non-blocking P4 hardening notes remain: (a) projectionRow at src/desktop-read-model.mjs:510 still emits 'authority_open: authorityOpen === true ? false : false', a dead ternary identical in pattern to the one closed at line 510-era sites; (b) the HERMES_REPO_ROOT env override at apps/desktop/src/main/main.mjs:15 and apps/desktop/scripts/capture-render.mjs:17 is still not gated or documented in docs/hermes-desktop-local-launch-runbook-2026-06-14.md. This review is read-only and does not authorize production PASS, enterprise PASS, protected closeout, deployment, independent GitHub approval, desktop write authority, tag push, or GitHub Release publication.

findings.title: Residual dead ternary in projectionRow mirrors the original finding pattern in a different helper
findings.details: While buildReleaseProjection lines 449-450 now hardcode tag_pushed and github_release_published to false (closing the originally flagged dead ternary), projectionRow at src/desktop-read-model.mjs:510 still emits 'authority_open: authorityOpen === true ? false : false'. Both branches resolve to false, so the input is ignored; the intent is clearly 'never trust artifact-supplied authority_open', which is correct and fail-closed, but the redundant ternary is the same code smell that the prior P3 finding called out and could be 'fixed' by a future reader to honor the input.
findings.recommendation: Replace 'authority_open: authorityOpen === true ? false : false' with a hardcoded 'authority_open: false' plus a one-line comment that desktop never opens projection-row authority regardless of artifact input. Apply the same shared-list/cleanup discipline used at the buildReleaseProjection site.
findings.evidence: Read src/desktop-read-model.mjs:503-514 (projectionRow definition: 'authority_open: authorityOpen === true ? false : false') vs. the cleanup at src/desktop-read-model.mjs:447-450 (tag_pushed, github_release_published explicit false).

findings.title: HERMES_REPO_ROOT env override is still not gated or documented in the desktop runbook
findings.details: apps/desktop/src/main/main.mjs:15 ('const REPO_ROOT = process.env.HERMES_REPO_ROOT ?? path.resolve(APP_DIR, "../..")') and apps/desktop/scripts/capture-render.mjs:17 still allow an operator to redirect the shell at an arbitrary directory. The prior review listed this as a residual risk; the candidate hardens preview symlink containment (which closes the main exploit path) but does not document the env override in docs/hermes-desktop-local-launch-runbook-2026-06-14.md and does not gate it to a small allowlist or emit a warning when set. In a single-owner local context this is acceptable, but a future packaged build that inherits an unexpected env value would silently look at the wrong root.
findings.recommendation: Either restrict HERMES_REPO_ROOT to an explicit allowlist (and fall back to APP_DIR/../.. otherwise) or document the env variable, its trust expectations, and a recommended unset/sanitize step in docs/hermes-desktop-local-launch-runbook-2026-06-14.md alongside the local launch flow. Mirror any change in apps/desktop/scripts/capture-render.mjs.
